name: Newton County, MS
findings: Newton County has 33 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Newton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Newton County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
